Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Events | HP News 9 | National Luv FM’s Clinton Yeboah wins Best Radio Feature at 30th GJA Media Awards Source : Myjoyonline.com 7 November 2026 11:19pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Luv FM journalist Clinton Yeboah has won the Best Radio Feature award at the 30th Ghana Journalists Association (GJA) Media Awards held in Accra on November 7, 2026.
The award recognises his work in radio feature production and adds to a series of honours he has received for his journalism.
Earlier in 2026, Mr Yeboah won two first-place awards in the Health and Business/Economy Journalism categories at the GJA Ashanti Regional Media Excellence Awards.
The latest recognition extends his award record across different areas of journalism.
Mr Yeboah works with Luv FM, a subsidiary of the Multimedia Group Limited.
The 30th GJA Media Awards were held under the theme, “Celebrating Excellence, Advancing Media Freedom and Combating Hate Speech in the Digital Age.”
The ceremony brought together journalists, media organisations and other stakeholders to recognise contributions to journalism in Ghana.
